# MIGRATION CHECKLIST
# Sources      : 2 — SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK, DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY
# Joins        : 2 — LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO: LeftOuter, JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP: LeftOuter
# Branches     : 2 — JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP (Branch 0 -> TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY, Branch 1 -> EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED), TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY (Branch 0 -> SORT_BY_ITEM)
# Computed cols: AVAILABLE_QTY, INVENTORY_VALUE, STOCK_STATUS, REORDER_REQUIRED, DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER, RECORD_HASH, SCD_EFF_START_DATE, SCD_EFF_END_DATE, IS_CURRENT_FLAG
# Sinks        : 2 — BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM, SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS
# Exceptions   : yes — SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS

"""
PySpark Migration Script for IBM DataStage Job: JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION
Description: Complex Inventory Reconciliation with SCD Type 2 and Lookup
Source DSX: JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import logging
import argparse

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, DataFrame
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# Setup JSON logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='%(message)s')
logger = logging.getLogger("JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION")


class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    def format(self, record):
        log_obj = {"timestamp": self.formatTime(record), "level": record.levelname}
        if isinstance(record.msg, dict):
            log_obj.update(record.msg)
        else:
            log_obj["message"] = str(record.msg)
        return json.dumps(log_obj)


handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
handler.setFormatter(JsonFormatter())
logger.handlers = [handler]

# CONFIG Dictionary
CONFIG = {
    "app_name": os.environ.get("APP_NAME", "JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION"),
    "source_db_url": os.environ.get("SOURCE_DB_URL", "jdbc:db2://localhost:50000/ERPDB"),
    "source_db_user": os.environ.get("SOURCE_DB_USER", "db2inst1"),
    "source_db_password": os.environ.get("SOURCE_DB_PASSWORD", "secret"),
    "ds_rundate": os.environ.get("DS_RUNDATE", "2026-07-27"),
    "warehouse_stock_path": os.environ.get("WAREHOUSE_STOCK_PATH", "/data/warehouse/stock_snapshot_2026-07-27.csv"),
    "exceptions_output_path": os.environ.get("EXCEPTIONS_OUTPUT_PATH", "/data/exceptions/inventory_exceptions_2026-07-27.csv"),
    "quarantine_path": os.environ.get("QUARANTINE_PATH", "/tmp/quarantine"),
    "broadcast_threshold": int(os.environ.get("BROADCAST_THRESHOLD", "10000000")),
    "shuffle_partitions": int(os.environ.get("SHUFFLE_PARTITIONS", "200")),
    "enable_row_count_validation": os.environ.get("ENABLE_ROW_COUNT_VALIDATION", "false").lower() == "true",
    "bq_project": os.environ.get("BQ_PROJECT", "acme-analytics-prod"),
    "bq_dataset": os.environ.get("BQ_DATASET", "supply_chain"),
}


def startup_validation():
    required_keys = ["source_db_url", "source_db_user", "source_db_password"]
    missing = [k for k in required_keys if not CONFIG.get(k)]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variables for CONFIG: {missing}")


def stage_SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK(spark: SparkSession) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK
    Type: PxSequentialFile
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK", "event": "entry"})
    df = spark.read \
        .option("header", "true") \
        .option("inferSchema", "true") \
        .csv(CONFIG["warehouse_stock_path"])
    logger.info({"stage": "SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df


def stage_DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY(spark: SparkSession) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY
    Type: PxDB2Connector
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY", "event": "entry"})
    sql_query = "SELECT ITEM_CODE, ITEM_DESC, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_ID, REORDER_LEVEL, LEAD_TIME_DAYS, IS_ACTIVE, EFF_START_DATE, EFF_END_DATE FROM ERP.ITEM_MASTER WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'"
    df = spark.read \
        .format("jdbc") \
        .option("url", CONFIG["source_db_url"]) \
        .option("driver", "com.ibm.db2.jcc.DB2Driver") \
        .option("user", CONFIG["source_db_user"]) \
        .option("password", CONFIG["source_db_password"]) \
        .option("query", sql_query) \
        .load()
    logger.info({"stage": "DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df


def stage_LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO(df_erp: DataFrame, df_supplier_ref: DataFrame = None) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO
    Type: PxLookup (Normal / Broadcast)
    Lookup Key: SUPPLIER_ID
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO", "event": "entry"})
    if df_supplier_ref is not None:
        df_out = df_erp.join(F.broadcast(df_supplier_ref), on="SUPPLIER_ID", how="left")
    else:
        df_out = df_erp
    logger.info({"stage": "LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP(df_stock: DataFrame, df_erp: DataFrame) -> (DataFrame, DataFrame):
    """
    DataStage Stage: JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP
    Type: PxJoin (LeftOuter)
    Join Key: ITEM_CODE
    Outputs: Branch 0 (matched/all left rows), Branch 1 (unmatched warehouse items)
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP", "event": "entry"})
    
    # Branch 0 — Matched left outer join
    df_matched = df_stock.join(df_erp, on="ITEM_CODE", how="left")
    
    # Branch 1 — Exception unmatched items
    df_unmatched = df_stock.join(df_erp, on="ITEM_CODE", how="left_anti") \
        .withColumn("_reject_reason", F.lit("Warehouse ITEM_CODE not found in ERP Master")) \
        .withColumn("_reject_date", F.current_date())
        
    logger.info({"stage": "JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_matched, df_unmatched


def stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_input: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY
    Type: PxTransformer
    Calculates SCD Type 2 fields, stock status, and record hash checksum.
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY", "event": "entry"})

    avail_qty_expr = F.col("ON_HAND_QTY") - F.col("RESERVED_QTY")
    inv_val_expr = F.col("ON_HAND_QTY") * F.col("UNIT_COST")
    
    stock_status_expr = F.when(avail_qty_expr == 0, "OUT_OF_STOCK") \
                         .when(avail_qty_expr < F.col("REORDER_LEVEL"), "LOW_STOCK") \
                         .otherwise("IN_STOCK")
                         
    reorder_req_expr = F.when(avail_qty_expr < F.col("REORDER_LEVEL"), 1).otherwise(0)
    days_reorder_expr = F.when(reorder_req_expr == 1, F.col("LEAD_TIME_DAYS")).otherwise(-1)
    
    hash_expr = F.sha2(F.concat_ws("||", 
        F.coalesce(F.col("ITEM_CODE"), F.lit("")),
        F.coalesce(F.col("WAREHOUSE_ID"), F.lit("")),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ON_HAND_QTY").cast("string"), F.lit("")),
        F.coalesce(F.col("UNIT_COST").cast("string"), F.lit(""))
    ), 256)

    df_out = df_input \
        .withColumn("AVAILABLE_QTY", avail_qty_expr) \
        .withColumn("INVENTORY_VALUE", inv_val_expr) \
        .withColumn("STOCK_STATUS", stock_status_expr) \
        .withColumn("REORDER_REQUIRED", reorder_req_expr) \
        .withColumn("DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER", days_reorder_expr) \
        .withColumn("RECORD_HASH", hash_expr) \
        .withColumn("SCD_EFF_START_DATE", F.current_date()) \
        .withColumn("SCD_EFF_END_DATE", F.to_date(F.lit("9999-12-31"))) \
        .withColumn("IS_CURRENT_FLAG", F.lit(1))

    logger.info({"stage": "TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED(df_unmatched: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED
    Type: PxPeekStage (Passthrough)
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED", "event": "entry"})
    df_out = df_unmatched
    logger.info({"stage": "EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_SORT_BY_ITEM(df_input: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """
    DataStage Stage: SORT_BY_ITEM
    Type: PxSortStage
    Sort Keys: ITEM_CODE ASC, WAREHOUSE_ID ASC
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "SORT_BY_ITEM", "event": "entry"})
    df_out = df_input.orderBy(F.col("ITEM_CODE").asc(), F.col("WAREHOUSE_ID").asc())
    logger.info({"stage": "SORT_BY_ITEM", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})
    return df_out


def stage_BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM(df_input: DataFrame, spark: SparkSession):
    """
    DataStage Stage: BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM
    Type: PxBigQueryConnector
    Write Mode: MERGE
    Target: acme-analytics-prod.supply_chain.inventory_dimension
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM", "event": "entry"})
    target_table = f"{CONFIG['bq_project']}.{CONFIG['bq_dataset']}.inventory_dimension"
    df_input.write \
        .format("bigquery") \
        .option("table", target_table) \
        .option("writeMethod", "indirect") \
        .mode("append") \
        .save()
    logger.info({"stage": "BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})


def stage_SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS(df_exceptions: DataFrame):
    """
    DataStage Stage: SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS
    Type: PxSequentialFile
    Path: /data/exceptions/inventory_exceptions_${DS_RUNDATE}.csv
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    logger.info({"stage": "SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS", "event": "entry"})
    df_exceptions.write \
        .option("header", "true") \
        .mode("overwrite") \
        .csv(CONFIG["exceptions_output_path"])
    logger.info({"stage": "SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS", "event": "exit", "duration_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)})


def main(run_mode: str = "full", dry_run: bool = False, log_level: str = "INFO"):
    logger.setLevel(getattr(logging, log_level.upper()))
    logger.info({"event": "pipeline_start", "job": "JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION", "run_mode": run_mode})
    
    startup_validation()

    spark = SparkSession.builder \
        .appName(CONFIG["app_name"]) \
        .config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", CONFIG["shuffle_partitions"]) \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "true") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled", "true") \
        .getOrCreate()

    try:
        # Step 1: Read Warehouse Stock
        df_stock = stage_SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK(spark)
        
        # Step 2: Read DB2 ERP Inventory
        df_erp_raw = stage_DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY(spark)
        
        # Step 3: Lookup Supplier Info
        df_erp_lookup = stage_LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO(df_erp_raw)
        
        # Step 4: Join Warehouse Stock & ERP Master
        df_matched, df_unmatched = stage_JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP(df_stock, df_erp_lookup)
        
        # Step 5: Process Exceptions
        df_exceptions = stage_EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED(df_unmatched)
        if not dry_run:
            stage_SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS(df_exceptions)
            
        # Step 6: Transform SCD2 Inventory
        df_scd2 = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_matched)
        
        # Step 7: Sort by Item Code & Warehouse ID
        df_sorted = stage_SORT_BY_ITEM(df_scd2)
        
        # Step 8: Write BigQuery Target
        if not dry_run:
            stage_BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM(df_sorted, spark)

        logger.info({"event": "pipeline_complete", "status": "success"})
    finally:
        spark.stop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION PySpark Migration")
    parser.add_argument("--run-mode", choices=["full", "incremental", "rerun"], default="full")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--log-level", default="INFO")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(run_mode=args.run_mode, dry_run=args.dry_run, log_level=args.log_level)

class TestTransformScd2Inventory:
    """Unit tests for TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY stage expressions."""

    def test_AVAILABLE_QTY_valid_input(self, spark):
        """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY | Expression: ON_HAND_QTY - RESERVED_QTY | Type: unit_test"""
        schema = StructType([
            StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
            StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
            StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True),
            StructField("REORDER_LEVEL", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("LEAD_TIME_DAYS", IntegerType(), True)
        ])
        data = [("ITEM-001", "WH-01", 100, 20, 15.50, 30, 5)]
        df_in = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
        df_out = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_in)
        assert df_out.collect()[0]["AVAILABLE_QTY"] == 80

    def test_INVENTORY_VALUE_valid_input(self, spark):
        """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY | Expression: ON_HAND_QTY * UNIT_COST | Type: unit_test"""
        schema = StructType([
            StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
            StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
            StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True),
            StructField("REORDER_LEVEL", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("LEAD_TIME_DAYS", IntegerType(), True)
        ])
        data = [("ITEM-001", "WH-01", 100, 20, 15.50, 30, 5)]
        df_in = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
        df_out = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_in)
        assert abs(df_out.collect()[0]["INVENTORY_VALUE"] - 1550.0) < 0.001

    def test_STOCK_STATUS_boundary(self, spark):
        """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY | Expression: If AVAILABLE_QTY = 0 Then OUT_OF_STOCK | Type: boundary_test"""
        schema = StructType([
            StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
            StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
            StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True),
            StructField("REORDER_LEVEL", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("LEAD_TIME_DAYS", IntegerType(), True)
        ])
        data = [
            ("ITEM-001", "WH-01", 50, 50, 10.0, 30, 5),   # AVAILABLE = 0 -> OUT_OF_STOCK
            ("ITEM-002", "WH-01", 50, 30, 10.0, 30, 5),   # AVAILABLE = 20 < 30 -> LOW_STOCK
            ("ITEM-003", "WH-01", 100, 20, 10.0, 30, 5)   # AVAILABLE = 80 >= 30 -> IN_STOCK
        ]
        df_in = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
        df_out = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_in)
        results = [row["STOCK_STATUS"] for row in df_out.collect()]
        assert results == ["OUT_OF_STOCK", "LOW_STOCK", "IN_STOCK"]

class TestTransformScd2Inventory:
    """Unit tests for TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY stage expressions."""

    def test_AVAILABLE_QTY_valid_input(self, spark):
        """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY | Expression: ON_HAND_QTY - RESERVED_QTY"""
        schema = StructType([
            StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
            StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
            StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True),

        df_in = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
        df_out = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_in)
        assert df_out.collect()[0]["AVAILABLE_QTY"] == 80

    def test_INVENTORY_VALUE_valid_input(self, spark):
        """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY | Expression: ON_HAND_QTY * UNIT_COST"""
        schema = StructType([
            StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
            StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
            StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True),
            StructField("REORDER_LEVEL", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("LEAD_TIME_DAYS", IntegerType(), True)
        ])
        data = [("ITEM-001", "WH-01", 100, 20, 15.50, 30, 5)]
        df_in = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
        df_out = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_in)
        assert abs(df_out.collect()[0]["INVENTORY_VALUE"] - 1550.0) < 0.001

    def test_STOCK_STATUS_boundary(self, spark):
        """DataStage stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY | Expression: If AVAILABLE_QTY = 0 Then OUT_OF_STOCK"""
        schema = StructType([
            StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
            StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
            StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True),
            StructField("REORDER_LEVEL", IntegerType(), True),
            StructField("LEAD_TIME_DAYS", IntegerType(), True)
        ])
        data = [
            ("ITEM-001", "WH-01", 50, 50, 10.0, 30, 5),
            ("ITEM-002", "WH-01", 50, 30, 10.0, 30, 5),
            ("ITEM-003", "WH-01", 100, 20, 10.0, 30, 5)
        ]
        df_in = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
        df_out = stage_TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY(df_in)
        results = [row["STOCK_STATUS"] for row in df_out.collect()]
        assert results == ["OUT_OF_STOCK", "LOW_STOCK", "IN_STOCK"]
